summary: End-to-end tested Gmail SMTP email notification + ETA feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (customer_email persists, PUT status=confirmed without eta_minutes -> 400, with eta_minutes=20 -> 200 with eta_minutes+eta_at set and notification event=confirmed ok=true within ~15s, ready event ok=true for pickup, completed does NOT create a notification, public GET /api/orders/{id} exposes eta_minutes, delivery order regression OK). Frontend customer flow: empty email at checkout shows toast 'Συμπλήρωσε έγκυρο email…'; with cantopizza1@gmail.com the order is created and /order/{id} renders confirm-email 'Ειδοποιήσεις στο cantopizza1@gmail.com'. Frontend admin flow: /admin/orders shows accept-<id>; clicking opens eta-dialog; clicking eta-20 flips row status to 'Επιβεβαιωμένη', detail panel shows order-eta 'Εκτίμηση: ~20'', success toast 'Αποδοχή — ο πελάτης ενημερώνεται με email (~20')'. Status-ready produces event=ready ok=true; status-completed produces NO notification. Customer /order/{id} after acceptance shows 'Έγινε αποδεκτή! Εκτίμηση ~20''. Real emails were sent to cantopizza1@gmail.com successfully. Iteration 7's 'auto-confirm ~30s' claim was NOT reproduced when no admin browser session was open — order 13559db7 stayed 'new' for 60s. First reproduction attempt in this run showed auto-confirm at t=10s, but that was after a prior playwright admin session had just closed and residual polling was likely present. Feature works correctly per spec.

minor.issue: Line 51 of the email HTML template has `{{"cash": "Μετρητά", "card_pos": "Κάρτα στο κατάστημα", "iris": "IRIS"}}.get(order.get("payment_method"), order.get("payment_method"))` inside an f-string. Because of the doubled `{{ }}` (f-string escape) this renders literally in the email body as `{"cash": "Μετρητά", ...}.get(order.get("payment_method"), ...)`  instead of the translated payment method label (e.g. 'Μετρητά'). Fix: build the label with a normal Python expression before the f-string, e.g. `pay_label = {"cash":"Μετρητά","card_pos":"Κάρτα στο κατάστημα","iris":"IRIS"}.get(order.get('payment_method'), order.get('payment_method',''))` then use `{pay_label}` in the f-string.

action_items: Fix cosmetic bug in mailer.py line 51 – payment method label is rendered literally in the email HTML instead of being translated (Μετρητά / Κάρτα στο κατάστημα / IRIS). Low priority, does not affect functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::update_status treats eta_minutes=0 as invalid (`not data.eta_minutes`) — same as None. Fine for current UI (buttons start at 15), but if a business ever wants to allow 0-min prep it would silently 400. Consider `data.eta_minutes is None`.

server.py::_notify runs inside FastAPI BackgroundTasks but uses `asyncio.run(_log_notification(...))` after SMTP. This works because BackgroundTasks executes the sync callable in a thread, but opens a new AsyncIOMotorClient per notification. Consider reusing the module-level `db` via `run_coroutine_threadsafe` or converting to a fully async task to avoid the connection churn.

server.py:387 `data.status in EMAIL_EVENTS and not (data.status == 'ready' and o.get('mode') == 'delivery')` — logic is correct (ready email only for pickup, delivering email only fires because 'delivering' is in EMAIL_EVENTS). A small refactor to a dict/table would be more readable.
mailer.send_email uses `os.environ[...]` directly (KeyError on missing config). Given .env already exists that's OK, but a startup validation would fail faster than at first send.
Orders.jsx – `accept-<id>` element is still a <span role='button'> (from iteration 7); real <button> would be more accessible. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% – customer checkout, admin ETA dialog, status transitions, customer /order page all pass

test_credentials: Admin cantopizza1@gmail.com / Telecanto2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); customer email recipient set to cantopizza1@gmail.com so all outbound mail goes to the store's own inbox as instructed.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 TEST_ prefixed orders during pytest + playwright runs. Ran a final cleanup pass that cancelled 8 non-terminal test orders. All remaining TEST_ orders are in 'cancelled' or 'completed' state — no pending alarm remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is functionally complete. Only one cosmetic issue remains: mailer.py:51 renders the payment_method dict literal in the email HTML (see backend_issues.minor). Iteration 7's auto-confirm anxiety was NOT reproducible when no admin browser session was open; a stray 10s auto-confirm during this run correlated with residual polling from an earlier Playwright admin session having just closed. When testing the alarm/auto-accept in the future, either wait ~30s after closing any admin session before starting the timer, or run the isolate script in a completely fresh backend process.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no critical bugs found. Minor mailer.py f-string escaping bug is documented above with the concrete fix.
